qa_pairs.question: What component is labeled C140 in the engine compartment?
qa_pairs.answer: C140 is the ignition coil, located on the RH side of the engine compartment.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I find the coolant level switch?
qa_pairs.answer: The coolant level switch (C106) is located on the RH side of the engine compartment, as shown in Figure 3.

qa_pairs.question: What components are shown in the RH rear corner of the engine compartment?
qa_pairs.answer: The RH rear corner of the engine compartment contains the battery junction block, evaporative purge valve relay, oxygen sensor/fuel pump relay, and main relay.

qa_pairs.question: Where is the washer pump located?
qa_pairs.answer: The washer pump is located on the RH side of the engine compartment, as shown in Figure 2.

qa_pairs.question: What sensor is located forward of the shock tower on the RH side?
qa_pairs.answer: The right front crash sensor is located on the RH side of the engine compartment, forward of the shock tower.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I locate the oxygen sensor?
qa_pairs.answer: The oxygen sensor is located in the lower RH rear of the engine compartment, as shown in Figure 6.
